caption: A close, slightly high-angle view shows a silver compact disc lying flat on a black hexagonal platform. Its underside flashes broad iridescent rainbow reflections around an orange central hub. A right hand is held at the right side throughout, fingertips resting on and sliding across the disc surface. The fingers first touch the right rim, then migrate inward to press near the orange hub, casting soft shadows that track their movement. They next sweep over the upper-left portion of the disc, then move back across the hub and out to the right edge, where they linger and slide along the rim. Later the hand spreads again across the left and top of the disc. The camera tilts slowly, gradually revealing more of a white panel with a red geometric pattern at the upper left.
